tasks.short: Check hours, shift allowances and manager mutation forms each period, then enter them as variable mutations in AFAS.

today.trigger: Period cut-off for the monthly and 4-weekly payroll runs, plus mutation emails from site managers during the period.
steps: Export clocked hours per site from the time registration system to Excel
Compare against rosters and manager emails for overtime, shift allowances (ORT) and corrections
Chase managers on missing approvals or odd totals
Key approved hours and adjustments into AFAS Profit as variable mutations
Tick off a checklist per site
drudgery: Retyping hours from Excel into AFAS
Chasing the same managers every period for sign-off
today.time_sinks: Matching three sources (clock, roster, email) by hand for about 750 shift workers and following up on missing approvals.

lenses.faster: A scheduled import loads hours into AFAS with CAO rules applied, so retyping and most cross-checking disappear.
lenses.autonomous: At cut-off the import runs, rule checks flag exceptions and managers get an automatic approval request for their own exceptions.
lenses.ambitious: Hours checked daily instead of at month end, so errors are fixed before they reach a payslip.
lenses.joy: No more retyping; the specialist only looks at the twenty odd cases instead of 750 rows.
lenses.options: Show the effect of each disputed correction on gross pay before choosing, instead of one answer.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the rule set (CAO allowances, rounding, tolerances) and the exception thresholds, not the data entry.
reach: HR Administrator: mutation intake from managers
Accountant: accrual of unpaid hours at month end

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether an unusual correction is a real agreement with the employee or a mistake, and holding managers to the CAO.
tasks.pattern_why: Hours, rosters and allowance rules are structured and can be written down; the output is checkable against the CAO.

in_practice.trigger: Payroll period cut-off date in AFAS calendar
steps: Import clocked hours and approved roster per employee into AFAS
Apply CAO allowance and overtime rules
Flag exceptions above set tolerances
Send exceptions to the responsible manager via AFAS workflow
Specialist reviews unresolved exceptions and releases the batch
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist releases the mutation batch before the test payroll run.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS mutation log with approver and timestamp

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports importing variable payroll mutations and approval workflows via InSite.
Rule-based allowance calculation from clock data removes most manual checking.

risks: Wrongly coded CAO rule pays hundreds of people wrong at once
Time registration data quality differs per site
research_questions: Which time registration system runs on each site and does it have an API or scheduled export?
What share of mutations today come from email rather than the clock system?
Can all CAO allowance rules for both CAOs be written as rules without exceptions?

tasks.short: Run the test payroll in AFAS, check gross-to-net, deductions and one-off payments before the final run.

steps: Enter remaining one-off items (bonuses, advances, garnishments) in AFAS
Run the test payroll (proefverloning)
Check gross-to-net on samples and on known changes
Fix errors and rerun
Run the final payroll and release payslips
today.time_sinks: Manual sampling of payslips and tracing why a net amount changed.

lenses.faster: AFAS already calculates; automated checks compare every payslip with last period and the expected change, so sampling stops.
lenses.autonomous: Test run and check report start automatically once mutations are released.
lenses.ambitious: Every payslip checked every period, not a sample, with zero corrections after payday as the target.
lenses.joy: Fewer reruns and late evenings before payday.
lenses.options: Run scenarios for retro CAO increases or tax changes before they land.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs and maintains the payroll controls and signs off the run.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist: costing CAO wage rounds

tasks.human_edge: Signing off pay under legal liability and handling garnishments and special cases.
tasks.pattern_why: Calculation stays in the payroll engine; checks are rules on structured output.

steps: Run test payroll in AFAS
Run automated checks per employee against last period and expected changes
List exceptions with a short explanation
Specialist fixes and approves
Run final payroll
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves the final payroll run.
systems: Power BI or Excel check workbook
in_practice.logs_to: Payroll run log and signed check report on SharePoint

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit Payroll calculates wages, loonheffing and the loonaangifte.

risks: Checks tuned too loose miss errors, too tight create noise
Using a language model to compute pay would be unreliable and unauditable
research_questions: How many corrections after payday occurred in the last 12 months and what caused them?
Which AFAS reports give per-employee period comparisons out of the box?

tasks.short: Keep vacation, ATV and sick leave balances right in AFAS, including CAO rights and expiry.

today.trigger: Leave requests, sick and recovery reports from managers, year-end and expiry dates.
steps: Receive leave requests and sick reports by email or AFAS
Register them in AFAS
Check balances against CAO rights and statutory expiry
Correct balances after contract changes
Answer employee questions on balances
today.time_sinks: Correcting balances after part-time changes and explaining them to employees.

lenses.faster: All requests go through AFAS InSite self-service with automatic accrual, so manual entry stops.
lenses.autonomous: Accrual, expiry warnings and pro-rata recalculation after contract changes run on events.
lenses.ambitious: Employees see a correct balance in real time and get warned before leave expires.
lenses.joy: No more retyping emails or answering 'how many days do I have'.
lenses.options: Show employees the effect of selling or buying leave days where the CAO allows it.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the leave rules in AFAS and audits them yearly against the CAO.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: verzuim reporting

tasks.human_edge: Explaining balances to an upset employee and handling disputed cases.
tasks.pattern_why: Leave rights and accrual are rule-based and live in structured records.

in_practice.trigger: Leave request, sick report or contract change in AFAS
steps: Employee or manager submits in AFAS InSite
Manager approves via workflow
AFAS updates balance with CAO rules
Expiry warnings go out automatically
Specialist checks exception list monthly
in_practice.human_gate: Manager approves leave; specialist resolves flagged balance corrections.

evidence.claim: AFAS InSite offers self-service leave requests with workflow approval.

risks: Sick leave data is health data under AVG; keep only what payroll needs
Shift workers without easy device access may not use self-service
Wrong accrual rule affects every balance
research_questions: What share of leave requests come via AFAS today versus email or paper?
Are both CAOs' leave rules already set up correctly in AFAS?
How many balance corrections are made per month?

tasks.short: Enter transfers, resignations, tax credit choices and other changes into payroll records in AFAS.

today.trigger: Emails and forms from HR Business Partners, managers and employees.
steps: Receive change by email or form
Check that the change is approved and complete
Enter in AFAS with the correct start date
Process final pay items for leavers (leave payout, vakantiegeld)
File documents in the personnel file
drudgery: Reading unstructured emails for the facts
today.time_sinks: Incomplete requests that need two or three emails before they can be entered.

lenses.faster: An AI step reads the email or form and prepares the AFAS mutation; the specialist checks and approves.
lenses.autonomous: Incomplete requests get an automatic reply naming what is missing.
lenses.ambitious: All changes arrive through one structured form so nothing is entered late.
lenses.joy: Less chasing; work starts from a prepared record.
lenses.options: For leavers, show final pay options such as leave payout versus taking days.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the change forms and validation rules.

tasks.human_edge: Deciding on unclear or retroactive changes and protecting personal data.
tasks.pattern_why: Input is unstructured and needs several steps, but each change must be approved before it counts.

in_practice.trigger: Change email or form arrives in the payroll mailbox
steps: Extract employee, change type, date and approver
Check against AFAS data and approval rules
Draft the AFAS mutation or a reply asking for missing data
Specialist approves
Post in AFAS and file source document
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves each mutation before posting.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS mutation log with linked source document

evidence.claim: Document and email extraction tools can turn forms into structured fields.

risks: Misread dates cause retroactive pay errors
Personal data (BSN) processed by an AI service needs a DPA and works council attention
research_questions: How many change requests per month arrive and in which formats?
Would a structured AFAS InSite form remove most of the need for an AI reader?
Does the OR consider this a change needing consent under WOR article 27?

tasks.short: Find and fix differences between hours, payroll results and agency invoices before and after each run.

today.trigger: Each payroll run and incoming agency invoices.
steps: Compare payroll totals with last period per site
Trace big differences to employees and mutations
Compare agency hours with time registration
Correct or ask managers and agencies
Note fixes for next period
drudgery: Building the same comparison sheet every period
Matching agency hours line by line
today.time_sinks: Tracing a single difference through several systems.

lenses.faster: Automated variance reports with likely causes replace the manual comparison sheet.
lenses.autonomous: Agency hours are matched to clock data on arrival and only mismatches surface.
lenses.ambitious: Check all three agencies' hours and invoices every week, which nobody does fully today.
lenses.joy: The specialist investigates real problems instead of building spreadsheets.
lenses.options: Rank discrepancies by money at stake so the biggest go first.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the control framework and tolerance levels.
reach: Controller: payroll reconciliation to the general ledger

tasks.human_edge: Deciding who is right in a dispute and negotiating corrections with agencies and managers.
tasks.pattern_why: Matching is rule-based, but explaining causes and drafting follow-ups needs judgment and approval.

in_practice.trigger: Test payroll run or agency hours file received
steps: Match records across AFAS, clock data and agency files
List differences above tolerance
Draft likely cause and correction for each
Specialist decides and sends follow-ups
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves every correction and message to agencies.

evidence.claim: Rule-based reconciliation with explanations drafted by a language model is feasible on structured exports.

risks: False alarms erode trust in the report
Agency portal exports differ in format and change without notice
research_questions: How much did agency overbilling or underbilling amount to last year?
Can the three agency portals export hours in a stable format?
Who owns agency invoice checks today: payroll or bookkeeping?

tasks.short: Fill in missing clock times and hours for staff who forgot to clock or work without a clock.

today.trigger: Missing or incomplete clock records, paper sheets from drivers and some sites.
steps: Get list of missing clock-ins
Ask managers or employees for the real times
Enter times from paper or email
Check against roster
drudgery: Asking the same people for times
today.time_sinks: Waiting on answers from shift managers.

lenses.faster: Missing times are proposed from roster and gate data and sent to the manager to confirm.
lenses.autonomous: Missing clock-ins trigger a same-day request to the employee or manager.
lenses.ambitious: Fix gaps the same day instead of at period end.
lenses.options: Offer the manager the roster time or the last known clock as choices.
lenses.altitude: The specialist removes the task by moving corrections to managers in the source system.

tasks.human_edge: Little; only disputed hours need a person.
tasks.pattern_why: Gaps are detectable by rule and proposed times come from structured data; paper sheets need only a reading step.

steps: Detect gaps against roster
Propose times and notify manager
Manager confirms in the system
Read any remaining paper sheets and queue for review

evidence.claim: Time registration systems commonly flag missing punches and support manager correction workflows.

risks: Filling in from rosters could pay for hours not worked
Works council must agree to changes in time registration (WOR art. 27)
research_questions: How many missing clock records occur per period per site?
Which staff groups still use paper sheets and why?

tasks.short: Set up new hires in AFAS payroll from offer, ID, tax form, bank details and pension enrolment.

today.trigger: Signed offer in Recruitee and contract from HR.
steps: Collect ID copy, loonheffingsverklaring and bank details
Retype offer and contract data into AFAS
Enrol in pension fund
Check first payslip
today.time_sinks: Missing documents before the first payday.

lenses.faster: Offer data flows from Recruitee into a draft AFAS record; documents are read and checked.
lenses.autonomous: A signed offer starts the onboarding flow and document requests automatically.
lenses.ambitious: Every new hire paid correctly on the first payday, which supports 90-day retention.
lenses.options: Not much need for options here.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the hire-to-payroll flow with HR and recruitment.

tasks.human_edge: Verifying identity documents and solving unusual tax or residence situations.
tasks.pattern_why: Several sources and documents; a person must check identity and approve the record.

steps: Create draft employee record in AFAS from offer
Send document request via AFAS InSite
Read documents into fields
Specialist checks and activates
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves before the employee enters payroll.

evidence.claim: Recruitee offers an API for candidate and offer data.

risks: BSN and ID copies are sensitive under AVG
Errors at entry repeat every period
research_questions: How many new hires per year end up with a first-payslip error?
Does the AFAS–Recruitee link exist already?

tasks.short: Compile hours, headcount and payroll totals for finance, pension fund and management reports.

today.trigger: After each payroll run and month end.
steps: Export payroll results from AFAS
Build Excel summaries per site
Send to finance and management
Answer follow-up questions

lenses.faster: Standard Power BI reports replace the Excel summaries.
lenses.ambitious: Labour cost per site per day for operations.
lenses.options: Cost scenarios for flex versus own staff.
lenses.altitude: The specialist defines report logic and data quality checks.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: HR dashboards

steps: Refresh AFAS extract
Run data checks
Publish reports
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist checks totals match the payroll journal.

evidence.claim: Power BI refreshes on the nightly AFAS extract.

risks: Different definitions between HR and finance
research_questions: Which reports are rebuilt by hand each period?
Do finance and HR agree on labour cost definitions?

role.altitude: Owner of the pay-cycle system: the CAO rules, input flows, controls and exception handling in AFAS, rather than the person who types and checks.
reach: HR Administrator: mutation and leave intake
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: costing CAO wage rounds
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: payroll and absence reporting
role.ceiling_note: About half the role's time on these tasks can be freed; legal liability for correct pay and the loonaangifte, CAO interpretation, employee trust and works council consent stay with people. As the single payroll FTE, the role is also a continuity risk.
skills_to_grow: Writing CAO rules as testable specifications
Data checks in Power Query or Power BI
AVG and EU AI Act basics for HR data
Process design with HR, finance and site managers
role.ambitious_version: Payroll closes in two days with every payslip checked, zero corrections after payday and agency hours reconciled weekly, so payroll becomes a control function for labour cost across all three sites.
